status: Frozen before new development data construction or training
execution_revision: First implementation and failed FP32 high-condition adjoint stress retained in revision1. Revision2 changes all branches to FP64 matrix construction/solve with read cast to original state dtype, adds condition-times-solver-epsilon gate and atomic resource-aware execution; no gradient tolerance, data, architecture, update budget or quality gate relaxed.
hypothesis: Scaling normalized-statistic ridge by inverse write mass removes pure normalization dilution, while potentially increasing conditioning costs; this need not benefit classification or financial gates specifically.
checkpoint_selection: Lowest length32 development validation cross entropy, every50 updates; no diagnostic-length model selection

gate_definitions.full: Original next/full_kernel compiled FullHX risk and Call; finance parameters fixed
gate_definitions.sigmoid: sigmoid(2z) risk, retaining exactly the same compiled FullHX Call; this differs deliberately from the old v4 sigmoid control
gate_definitions.c1: q=.5+.5*z*abs(z)/(1+z*z), a=relu(-z)^2/(1+relu(-z)^2); stable extreme branches, no financial table
gate_definitions.memory: No fast/slow dynamics; original learned generic key/value/write projections
gate_definitions.mass: Read with symmetrized G+.01*r*I; no numerical ridge floor or detached mass gradient

precision: State and learned parameters remain float32. G,H,r,query cast to float64 before matrix construction/solve in ALL branches; read cast back to state dtype. JAX x64 configuration required and checked. State-rounding sensitivity remains separately reported.
comparison: Identical initial parameters and widths across all three dynamic families and ridge modes; pure-memory width chosen to match parameter target. Persistent state and FLOPs reported, not matched.

development_gate.meaning: Candidate-mechanism screen only. Passing authorizes a separate frozen confirmation protocol; it does not establish financial-gate superiority or authorize backbone pretraining.

freshness: New development RNG bases and initialization seeds; input fingerprints and exact development-evaluation overlap against all old v3/v4 train/evaluation inputs at matching lengths checked before training. No new confirmation set is constructed.
limits: Old-checkpoint counterfactuals are exploratory and never count as new confirmation success
Condition<=101 applies only to fixed mode; mass mode has bound1+sum(w)/.01 in exact arithmetic
Single final-query solve is sequence-to-one, not token-by-token language decoding
No extra HPO, failed-seed replacement, or threshold changes after development outcomes
Synthetic tasks do not establish multimodal or large-backbone advantages
